beats.text: This pull request adds a background job, and changes a schedule.
The new job is expire keys. It deletes API keys that are past their date.
The service puts it on the queue whenever a key is revoked.
Separately, the scheduler starts the usage sync on a timer.
That timer used to fire every hour. Now it fires every five minutes.
One thing to check. Each run reads the whole usage table, and it now runs twelve times as often.
